Hand-crafted fixture for ARX-CONSTRUCTS-350.

Covers `\texorpdfstring{TeX}{PDFstring}`:
- In `\section` heading: PDF-string variant ("x squared") is emitted, since
  markdown headings are plain text.
- Inline body: PDF-string variant ("alpha") is emitted.
- Inside `$...$`: math is preserved verbatim, so the literal
  `\texorpdfstring{...}{...}` source rides along with the surrounding MathSpan.

See src/arxiv_md/tex/transform/inline.py::TexOrPdfStringHandler.
